datasets.title: Georgia Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 584.0 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 36% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 9% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. AI-assisted mapping was used to estimate total building coverage (36% of estimated total buildings mapped). Data were exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for use in exposure assessment and disaster risk analysis.
